verdict.rationale: Polar documents an official remote MCP server with production and sandbox endpoints (mcp.polar.sh). It uses OAuth sign-in, so no API key needs to be copied into the agent. Agents can look up data and take actions across products, customers, subscriptions, orders and benefits. Setup is documented for Cursor, Claude Code (exact `claude mcp add` command), ChatGPT and Claude Desktop, and a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and operate successfully, beyond first-party docs.
